predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Select STOXX Europe Aerospace & Defense ETF

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability move coincides with a concrete headline (drone/missile strike, airspace breach). If no news, treat as noise and reduce conviction.
time_plan.1h: Compare EUAD/ITA pre-market or futures vs broad index; confirm defense is outperforming, not just moving with beta.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether NATO officials or member governments issue statements; escalation confirmation strengthens thesis, de-escalation language reverses it.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate whether move is sustained or faded; watch US/EU defense sector breadth and options skew.
time_plan.12h: Mark final move; if Article 5 talk receded without event, expect mean reversion toward baseline.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of a NATO Article 5 invocation signals a material escalation of armed conflict involving a NATO member (e.g., a Russian attack spilling into NATO territory, Baltic/Poland incursion). Defense procurement expectations rise immediately on such news, and aerospace/defense names are the most direct beneficiary. European defense is especially geared since the fiscal and rearmament impulse would be centered on the continent.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify the probability spike is driven by a real conflict escalation headline rather than low-liquidity market noise.
time_plan.1h: Check EUR/USD, Bund futures, and VSTOXX for corroborating risk-off; equity-only moves without rates/FX confirmation are suspect.
time_plan.2h: Watch for official NATO/EU response; a confirmed escalation deepens the drawdown.
time_plan.6h: Reassess whether selloff is broadening to US indices (SPX) or contained to Europe.
time_plan.12h: Record final level; if the scare fades, expect partial recovery and lower realized move than headline threshold.

predictions.reasoning: An Article 5 scenario implies direct NATO-Russia military engagement on or near European soil, a severe risk-off shock. Broad European equities would sell off on growth, energy-supply, and war-risk premia, with the euro area most directly exposed. This is the clearest macro directional implication of a jump in war probability.

evidence_used: Market question ties resolution to an actual NATO Article 5 invocation, which requires an armed attack on a member — a major escalation event
Historical pattern: war-escalation shocks lift defense stocks and safe havens while pressuring European risk assets
uncertainty_notes: Probability moves on Polymarket can be thin/noisy and may not reflect genuine new information
A true Article 5 event is a tail scenario; most probability moves will be marginal and produce sub-threshold asset moves
12h window may not capture the full reaction if the triggering headline arrives outside market hours

llm_justification.summary: A sharp increase in the implied probability of a NATO Article 5 invocation would reflect escalation toward direct NATO-Russia conflict in Europe. The cleanest liquid mappings are: defense equities higher (procurement/rearmament bid) and broad European equities lower (risk-off, war premium). Both moves scale with the severity of the underlying trigger; absent a concrete escalation headline, the market signal is likely noise and moves will fall short of the 700bps tradable threshold.
key_assumptions: A material probability rise is accompanied by a genuine conflict-escalation catalyst
Defense ETFs and European indices retain their historical sensitivity to war-risk news
The information is not already fully priced into public markets
failure_modes: Probability move is low-liquidity noise with no real-world catalyst, so assets barely react
The escalation news is already public and priced, leaving no edge
De-escalation/diplomatic resolution reverses the move within the window
Defense and index moves stay below the 700bps tradable bar for ordinary escalation headlines
Proxy mismatch: broad indices may be cushioned by central-bank or fiscal response expectations, muting the downside
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
